root_cause: This run has two unrelated, pre-existing, recurring CI infrastructure failures, neither caused by PR #38204 (which only touches intel_gpu FC-compression transformations/tests): (1) the sccache server fails to start in the Build (C++20) job because the Azure Blob Storage URI it builds contains a doubled slash ('ghasccacheblobs.blob.core.windows.net//sccache/...'), which Azure's Blob API rejects with HTTP 400 InvalidUri - this happens during CMake's trivial C-compiler-check test compile, before any PR-specific code is touched, and is the same signature recorded 5 times previously (pattern 08b993dbdc18ccac); (2) the PyTorch Models tests job's Detectron2 precommit suite fails because the external model-hub host serves an expired TLS certificate, triggering CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED on every download attempt - the same signature recorded 6 times previously (pattern 2641a2995515ec82, which crossed the 3-occurrences-in-12h recurring-escalation threshold again with this run).
reproduction_steps: N/A - both failures are CI-infrastructure/external-service issues (sccache Azure Blob cache misconfiguration and an expired upstream TLS certificate), not reproducible by rebuilding PR #38204's code locally.
recommended_actions: Fix the sccache Azure Blob Storage configuration so the computed blob URI never contains a doubled '/' (sanitize trailing slashes when concatenating the storage account URL with SCCACHE_AZURE_KEY_PREFIX in the CI environment/action that sets these variables) - now 6 occurrences, needs owner escalation.

Wait for the external model-hub host's TLS certificate to be renewed, or mirror/cache the Detectron2 model assets in an OpenVINO-controlled store - now 7 occurrences in <12h, a human-review rerun-pattern PR (#39754) is already pending merge for this signature.
Automated remediation requested for this run (re-run failed jobs / re-queue depending on live merge-queue status) since both categories are transient/config-infra, not code-caused.
No code changes required on PR #38204.
prevention_strategies: Validate the SCCACHE_AZURE_* environment variables at CI setup time to catch a malformed/double-slash URI before it reaches sccache. For model-hub tests, consider caching/mirroring frequently-used assets in an OpenVINO-controlled store to avoid dependency on third-party certificate hygiene, and merge the pending workflow-rerunner PR (#39754) for the certificate-expiry signature.
